layout.panel_seams: fixed art joins; continuous ground/sky/horizon; no animation

assets.visual: Begin on a single blue tessera in the hands of a careful mosaic artisan. The artisan's scribed guiding line becomes a winding cobbled street. Along that street, more hands and trades appear, differentiated but visually connected. The left edge is the start of the narrative, not an isolated title card.
assets.left_edge: Origin: a bright blue tessera on dark stone.
assets.right_edge: Stone street and tool marks continue into a real town at the exact same horizon.

lyrics: Hockey sticks climbing on a glowing screen
Same old numbers in the morning news
A cook knows fire, a coder knows the keys
assets.visual: Continuous morning town street: one shopkeeper reading a modest economic newspaper, an upward capability curve on a single workshop screen, a cook working with fire next door, and a coder working with keys. The comparison is visually clear without relying on tiny generated lettering.
assets.left_edge: Continue the cobbled road, artisan's workbench and stone walls from panel 00.
assets.right_edge: Kitchen/coder/workshop activities converge through shared deliveries and a corridor into an organization.

lyrics: Now the agents join the picture
Is it everything they know alone / Or what they learn to do in tune?
assets.visual: From the left, distinct workshops with cooperative specialists join into one functioning organization: people exchanging tools, food, designs, and computation. A recognizably artificial collaborator appears beside humans using tools, not a giant face or central hero. Visual metaphor: parts making a larger productive system without losing identity.
assets.left_edge: Kitchen, code and workbench flow into the same physical building from panel 01.
assets.right_edge: Organization's logistics lead naturally into producing and delivering physical goods.

lyrics: More on the shelves, less on the tags
A million minds and a modest graph
If everything grows and the prices fall
Who gets to take it home?
Whose windows glow when the engines shine?
assets.visual: Connected workshop-to-market-to-residential street: overflowing market shelves, smaller price tags as visual proportions (do not require readable text), an understated graph, and a person weighing whether they can afford goods. Beyond the shop are lived-in upper windows: some illuminated warm, others dark. All fixed, no magical lighting changes.
assets.left_edge: Delivery cart and the same roadway emerge from the organization production area.
assets.right_edge: Market street bends past homes toward a quiet stained-glass transition about individual lives.
assets.medium: mosaic with optional static stained-glass windows

assets.visual: A coherent meditative passage along the same city street: people of different lives and colors, a recurring blue tessera motif and gold grout articulating interdependence. Visual counterpoint becomes legible as ONE scene rather than disjoint icons. A static architectural arch transitions the street toward agricultural land.
assets.left_edge: Continue same inhabited windows and street from panel 03.
assets.right_edge: Urban cobbled road becomes a country path toward fields with a consistent ground line.

lyrics: The farm was forty parts of the pie
Now it's two, though the harvest climbs
More in the fields, less on the chart
Who's got the wages to sing along?
One point a year becomes a rising tide
assets.visual: A continuous agricultural landscape from left to right: older labor-intensive field transforms visually across SPACE (not time) into highly productive harvest and distribution; in the stone border, a deliberately small economic-share diagram 40 to 2 is set in simple fixed shapes. The abundant harvest enters a market where wages matter. A thin tide-like river carries a subtle compounding-growth metaphor.
assets.left_edge: Country road and stone boundary from panel 04 lead straight into visible crops.
assets.right_edge: Farm-to-market road reaches a familiar town with employment paths and doors.

lyrics: Might have better work to do
assets.visual: On a coherent street, a worker stands between an old occupied workshop and a newly opened but uncertain doorway. Some wages and prospects decline while opportunities elsewhere appear, no predetermined happy ending. A doorway is clearly an invitation but not an accomplished passage. No multiple timelines or magical portals.
assets.left_edge: Market and town road continue from panel 05.
assets.right_edge: Road continues forward into a different district of inhabited city windows.

lyrics: More on the shelves, less on the tags
Who gets to take it home?
The world can change more than the numbers show
assets.visual: Another neighborhood farther EAST along the same physical city, not a repeated tile or a return to an earlier one. Richly observed apartment lives; different households, one sees abundance, one has uncertainty. Shops, transport and the quiet economic graph are visible as street details. The repeated question becomes more complicated after the farm and wage scenes.
assets.left_edge: The uncertain worker from panel 06 can be seen entering city road at edge.
assets.right_edge: The inhabited street expands into a gathering public plaza/civic square.
assets.medium: mosaic / static stained glass as optional chorus accent

lyrics: Two points higher on the jobless line
And the streets have something to say this time
The future isn't only what the machines know how
assets.visual: Public square and institutions: economically displaced workers and ordinary citizens speaking and deliberating; civic stone facade, labor concerns and public control visibly coexist with productive machines and the city. A tiny graph in masonry alludes to unemployment. No riots invented; human choice is central, not machines smashing institutions.
assets.left_edge: The second residential district becomes a plaza with gathering people.
assets.right_edge: A library or scholarly portal emerges from the public square.
assets.medium: mosaic relief with static carved stone

lyrics: I used to see the borders of everything I knew
Now I can cross the disciplines
Where the old maps used to end
assets.visual: The same individual researcher enters a connected library and laboratory: historically legible stacks and instruments unfolding into adjacent maps of astronomy, economics, mathematics, computer science and other fields. Farther right the researcher is exploring methods beyond the previous borders. The emphasis is interdisciplinary access, not papers multiplying magically.
assets.left_edge: Library portico connects to civic plaza's street.
assets.right_edge: Open books and maps lead into an intimate inspection of evidence and tessera seams.
assets.medium: fine glass tesserae and illuminated manuscript motifs

lyrics: I draw the question / You trace the ground
Leave the joins where we can see
I still write the final line
assets.visual: Close-readable research table: physical source manuscript, a chart with documented observation, a separate sketch or imaginative proposal, a seam between them; the author tests evidence and pens the final line while collaborators' work stays visible. The mosaic's own genuine grout tessera detail should be exquisite at macro scale. Source is not proved by its label: provenance should be inspectable.
assets.left_edge: Scientific maps and scholarly materials continue from panel 09.
assets.right_edge: Researcher's written pages and a blue tessera motif enter a larger aspirational public landscape.

lyrics: More on the shelves, less on the tags
May we find a way to bring it home
assets.visual: Third, farther-east neighborhood as HOPEFUL POSSIBILITY, not a solved prediction. A broad sunrise-colored city of individual households, accessible markets and shared benefit; distinctive workers and researchers link directly to human flourishing. The imagery should visibly echo prior scenes without copying them. Windows are depicted luminous in the completed artwork; they never switch on.
assets.left_edge: Researcher's desk overlooks or visually leads into connected human city.
assets.right_edge: Window arches resolve into makers' tools and glass motifs preparing the outro.
assets.medium: monumental static stained-glass accent may flank mosaic

assets.visual: End the rightward visual journey with the same individual tessera from opening, now legible in the context of a vast accumulated composition. A mosaic artist's hand and a meticulously detailed gold-grouted seam return. This is an ending, not a triumphant claim that all problems were solved. Keep material boundaries explicitly visible. The final song seconds will use CAMERA DOLLY OUT from this region.
assets.left_edge: Warm city and window traceries from panel 11 transform spatially into glass artist workshop.
assets.right_edge: Visually resolved edge of the completed frieze, ample space for 3D camera reveal.
assets.medium: ceramic and glass tesserae with visible honest joins
